name: Crystals, Gems and Jewels: Amethyst Ward

system.description:
Crystal Weapon Dance. Summoned creatures infused with your Crystal Weapon, gain temporary hit points equal to the rank they were summoned at, at the beginning of each of your turns. (D-Rank: 4 Temporary hit points, C-Rank: 8 Temporary hit points, B-Rank: 12 Temporary hit points, A-Rank: 16 Temporary hit points, S-Rank: 20 Temporary hit points)

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a rank of Mastery to resist Mental conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.
